newsitem.title: POLAND: NBP DRAINS PLN 984 MLN FROM POLISH MONEY MARKET.
newsitem.headline: NBP DRAINS PLN 984 MLN FROM POLISH MONEY MARKET.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland drained a total of 984 million zlotys from the market through a reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction after banks bid to place 1.7 million with the central bank, the NBP said.
The maximum rate for the one-day operation, at which the bank absorbed 632 million zlotys from bids of 652 million zlotys, was flat at 21.50 percent.
At the five day drainage the bank set the maximum rate at 21.60 percent and took in 352 million zlotys worth of bids totalling 1.032 billion zlotys.
